description: This file contains the main application component for a React-based frontend. It includes a custom hook to detect viewport size and a component to display an overlay when the viewport is below a certain width, effectively blocking access on non-desktop devices. The file imports React, styles, assets, and routing components, and exports the main App component that manages routing or shows an overlay.

methods.name: useIsBelowDesktopBreakpoint(breakpoint = 1024)
methods.description: A custom React hook that detects if the current viewport width is below a specified breakpoint (default 1024px). It listens to window resize events and updates the component state accordingly.

methods.name: DesktopOnlyOverlay()
methods.description: A React functional component that displays an overlay informing users that the app requires a desktop environment. It shows a logo and messaging, and is rendered when the viewport is narrower than the breakpoint.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: The root React component that either renders the DesktopOnlyOverlay for narrow viewports or delegates rendering to AppRoutes for wider screens. It manages the blocking behavior based on viewport size.
